about: Input rows for tools/budget-seven.mjs: per-frame CPU physics-step cost for N = 1..7 simultaneous ragdolls, with and without cuts. Nothing about the scenes is hard-coded in the tool. This is the cost of one 60 Hz tick of the shared physics world (motors, Jolt step, readPose for every body), NOT GPU render cost, skinning or draw calls.
spacing_source: own start value: a boss is about 2.1 m tall, so 2.5 m keeps the ragdolls from touching each other; the cost under crowding is a separate row to add
max_simultaneous_ragdolls_source: Strategy ruling 2026-10-28: the 3 ms budget stays and the count is capped instead. #64 measured seven simultaneous dying+cut bosses at 3-4 ms p95 CPU, over budget; bosses past the cap take the baked death. Games read this row and call admit() from the package.
budget_source: docs/BRIEF.md: the 3 ms physics budget (five fighters + one cut) that test/budget.test.mjs guards

motor_strength.source: test/budget.test.mjs: same motor pattern as the M3 proof scene

sets.note: seven different Mixamo-106 boss bodies; ragdoll N uses the first N of this list. All are 20-part ragdolls, so the part count does not change with the rig, only masses and lengths do.
heaviest measured boss (140 kg clamp) repeated: the worst mass case
